OPENSTREETMAP INPUT
===================

Purpose
-------
The routing scripts use an OpenStreetMap PBF file to build the pedestrian and
street network used by r5py.

Expected filename and location
------------------------------
Place the file at:

    <repository-root>/nyc.osm.pbf

The current routing scripts resolve this path from the repository root.

Public source
-------------
Geofabrik New York downloads:
https://download.geofabrik.de/north-america/us/new-york.html

Current statewide PBF download:
https://download.geofabrik.de/north-america/us/new-york-latest.osm.pbf

Important provenance note
-------------------------
The archived project file appears to be an NYC-specific extract, but its
original download URL and clipping procedure were not recorded. Therefore, the
Geofabrik New York file is a reproducible replacement source, not proof that it
is byte-for-byte identical to the file used in the original analysis. It is
also larger because it covers the whole state.

Archived project copy
---------------------
Filename: nyc.osm.pbf
SHA-256: 0ab7e387d87cddd0e8a1b1ab37f887ace39dcd6adba4650fe2d403cd960fe521

For exact replication, preserve a copy matching this checksum in a durable
research archive such as Zenodo or OSF and add its permanent URL here. OSM data
changes over time, so a newly downloaded extract may produce slightly different
routing results.

This large binary file is intentionally excluded from Git.
